Problems with the rectum are common. They include hemorrhoids , abscesses, incontinence and cancer . Many people are embarrassed to talk about rectal troubles. But seeing your doctor about problems in this area is important. This is especially true if you have pain or bleeding. Treatments vary depending on the particular problem.
